version.author: Kamil Baranski (kamilbaranski.com)
version.changelog: + Renamed to kb_Visual Metronome Flasher + Smoother flash: full-brightness hit with a soft (squared) decay instead of a dim, linear blink + Fade is always scaled to fit the beat interval (no more cut-off flashes at fast tempos) + Sample-accurate beat detection + New divisions: every 2, 3, 4 and 6 beats + Fixed color calculation (HSV)

version.author: Kamil Baranski (kamilbaranski.com)
version.changelog: + Separate color and brightness for the bar downbeat (can be turned off) + Brightness for both colors + Selectable decay curve + Fade is now drawn from wall-clock time, so it no longer depends on the GUI/audio block timing + Renamed to kb_Visual Metronome Flasher, new divisions: 2, 3, 4, 6 beats
